_comment: Vercel Cron config is NOT what actually runs in production — this app deploys via Docker (see docker-entrypoint.sh), which wires its own crond schedule (currently /api/cron every 6h, leads-notify + orders-notify every 5min, kpi-report daily, alerts/digest daily). This file is kept only as documentation of intended cron routes for a hypothetical Vercel deploy. Previously listed several paths with no matching route.ts at all (budget-check, cpl-monitor, anomaly, auto-apply, alerts/digest, cron/audience-compare, cron/cleanup-drafts) — removed at the time; alerts/digest was added back once it got a real implementation.
